parsed.internal_thinking: I have 2 Wood and 3 Wheat. My Brick (B6 at Hex 5) is currently blocked by the robber, and Alice is also on that hex at Node 20. She has a surplus of Wood and Sheep, but she has been blockading me on Brick. Charlie has also been refusing Brick trades. I cannot build a road or settlement without Brick. I have enough Wheat to try and trade for the Brick I desperately need to reach the Wheat port at Node 3, which would allow me to bypass their blockade in the long run. I'll propose a trade to Charlie first, as he was slightly more cooperative recently by trading me Wheat.
parsed.note_to_self: Blockade on B6 continues. Alice is also on Hex 5 (Node 20), so the robber hurts her too, yet she won't trade. Targeting Node 3 for the Wheat port to gain independence.
parsed.say_outloud: Charlie, you've been reasonable before. I'm stuck behind these trees and could use a single brick to get moving. Wheat for brick?
